column1: # Stage S6 X6 — the S6 switch: every consumer of a module the S6 births moved into a crate imports that crate directly, and the map engine's re-export shims go.
# One module prefix of the S6 shim ledger per block, as a `crate::` row scoped to the map engine and
# a `map_engine::` row for each of the two outside consumers, the single-page app and the developer
# tools. Longest prefix wins, so the world line of sight's module rows precede its catch-all row.
# Item imports a prefix cannot name (the world store's error, a module imported under its own name
# and used by short path) are rewritten by hand.
# the camera reads `cluster_mode` through the old path in a file of another stage, so the
# map engine row is scoped to the two folders that are this stage's
